title: PlayerStateActions: shared vtable slot +0x10 SetAction = 0x4058E0 (type dispatch 0x405D64/0x405D50, dir<8/type<=0x32 entry bounds, frame formula start[state]+storedDir*3000+argDir*10, common tail 0x405CD7 with dir-7 special and slow-mo double), 33-row player frame table 0x8AA5C0 (start/frames/ms per state, init 0x449C80/0x449C50, 0x449C9C-0x449F5B), monster table 0x8AA686 (states 0-8 + race extension), NPC table 0x8AA6C8, riding machine 0x410B00 (states 7/0x10/0x11/dir-walk/stand, guard flags 0x629D1-D4==0 gate, step thresholds 0x62A77, fx/msg pairing), horse machine 0x40E400 (msgs 0x51A/0x51B/0x51C), tick driver 0x411AB0 (state-5 byte counter, 0x17 double-speed + end-anim 0x17->7 restore), spawn-fx 0x40CD00 (fx 0x21/0x22/0x23/1 per state), handler pairs [0xEC]=1/2/3, restore helper 0x410720
objective: Close the pending item of EI-279 state-frame-tables-evidence.json (state 0..32 action-semantic naming) and provide the authoritative primary-static reference for the player action-state machine: the SetAction entry point (shared vtable slot +0x10, 0x4058E0), its dispatch and validation, the frame-table layout and fill chain, per-state timing/semantics including the riding machine and horse machine state writers, the tick/auto-transition logic, and per-state effect triggers. Builds on EI-279 (frame tables 0x8AA5C0/0x8AA686/0x8AA6C8, row writer 0x449C50, table constructor 0x449C80, lookups 0x44A240/0x44A820/0x44A090, frame advance 0x40C4B0) and EI-282/283 (player composition, render flags).
question: How does the player action-state machine work end to end? What are the exact validation bounds and frame formulas in SetAction? What are the 33 player table rows and their semantic names? Which writers drive states 7/0x10/0x11 (riding), 0x15/0x16/0x1E/0x1F/0x17/5 (special pair families), and 0x13/0xF/0x20 (completion returns)? How do the tick driver and spawn-fx emitter advance and decorate the animation?
method: Primary-static disassembly of /tmp/nas_mnt/NAS/TMP/EI传奇3.0客户端/Mir3.exe (VA base 0x400000) via Tools/reverse-engineering/disasm_capstone.py plus custom capstone/raw-byte scans over .text (offset = 0x1000 + (VA-0x401000)) and the full PE image for E8-call/imm32-pointer patterns. Full disassembly of: 0x4058E0 (SetAction entry, dispatch, all four type paths, common tail), 0x405CD7 (common tail), 0x405D50/0x405D64 (jump/byte tables), 0x449C80 (table constructor) and 0x449C50 (row writer) incl. the full init chain 0x449C9C-0x44A081, 0x40CD00 (spawn-fx), 0x411AB0 (tick driver) and 0x411C55-0x4120B0 (completion/auto-transition tail), 0x410B00 (riding machine) and 0x410C52-0x410ECB (dir-walk/0x10/0x11/stand blocks), 0x40E400 (horse machine, msgs 0x51A/0x51B/0x51C), 0x410720 (restore helper), 0x40D420-0x40DF00 (handler pairs: 0x40DB40/0x40DC20/0x40D7A1/0x40D882/0x40D9FD, completion returns 0x40DE9D-0x40DEB6), 0x40A4D0 (step-fx selector), 0x451450 (msg sender), 0x45AFC0 (fx emitter). Raw-byte scans for all imm32 references to 0x8AA5A8/0x8AA6C8 and to call 0x449C80/0x44A8B0.

source.setaction_slot: vtable slot +0x10 (4th entry) of the shared actor vtable family: vtables 0x476480 (human), 0x4763D0, 0x476554, 0x47672C (verified entry dwords; slot pattern e.g. 0x476480+0x10 points to 0x4058E0). ThisCALL convention: SetAction(ecx=actor, arg1=[esp+0x14]=state, arg2=[esp+0x18]=dir); call sites push dir then state (right-to-left) then call [vt+0x10] (verified at riding 0x410CD6/0x410D44, horse 0x40E546/0x40E581, tick 0x411C77).
source.table_obj: 0x8AA5A8 (BSS singleton; this of constructor 0x449C80 invoked at 0x402046 with mov ecx,0x8AA5A8, test eax, jne 0x40205F). Frame tables are fields of this object: human table at obj+0x18 = 0x8AA5C0 (33 rows, stride 6), monster table at obj+0xDE = 0x8AA686 (states 0-8 seeded, race fn 0x44A240 extends), NPC table at obj+0x120 = 0x8AA6C8 (3 rows). Per-object cache [actor+0x90] = 0x5600FC + [actor+0x8C]*324 (computed lazily in SetAction at 0x405900-0x40591C; 324 = 54 rows x 6).

prior.EI-279: state-frame-tables-evidence.json (row writer 0x449C50, constructor 0x449C80, lookups 0x44A240/0x44A820/0x44A090, frame advance 0x40C4B0; its pending defers state-name enumeration to this finding)
prior.EI-282/EI-283: player-composition/render-flags evidence (type byte [actor+0x88], stored dir [actor+0x8A], sub-dir [actor+0x8B], table type [actor+0x8C])

setaction_dispatch.entry_checks: 0x4058E0: al=[esp+8] (arg2 dir); cmp al,8; jae bail 0x405D47 (dir must be <8). al=[esi+0x8C] (table-type index); cmp al,0x8C; jae bail. If [esi+0x90]==0: compute lazy per-object row base [esi+0x90] = 0x5600FC + ([esi+0x8C]*9*9*4) i.e. +[esi+0x8C]*324 (0x405900-0x40591C). al=[esi+0x88] (object type byte); cmp eax,0x32; ja bail (type must be <=50 = 0x32). Dispatch: dl = byte[eax + 0x405D64]; jmp dword[edx*4 + 0x405D50].
setaction_dispatch.byte_table_0x405D64: 33 bytes indexed by type 0..0x32, values {0,1,4,2,4,4,...} (byte-verified): type 0 -> idx0, type 1 -> idx1, type 2 -> idx4, type 3 -> idx2, types 4..0x31 -> idx4, type 0x32 -> idx3. Jump table 0x405D50 (5 dwords): {0x405942, 0x405997, 0x405A0F, 0x405BBB, 0x405D47}.

type_paths.type0_human: 0x405942: cl=[esi+0x8A] (stored dir); cmp cl,9; jae bail. cmp byte[esp+0x14],0x21; jae bail (state < 0x21 = 33). frame [0xB4] = word[0x8AA5C0 + 6*state] + (storedDir*3*5*5*4)*5 + argDir*10 = start[state] + storedDir*3000 + argDir*10 (0x405975-0x40598F); [0xB8] = [0xB4] + word[0x8AA5C2+6*state] (frames); [0xBC] = word[0x8AA5C4+6*state] (duration ms).
type_paths.type1_variant: 0x405997: identical formula and bounds to type 0 (stored dir<9, state<0x21; [0xB4] = start[state] + storedDir*3000 + argDir*10, reads the SAME table 0x8AA5C0; 0x4059D8-0x4059E7). Earlier working notes claiming a 750/40-stride difference for type 1 are WRONG and superseded: both human paths share the 3000/10 layout; type 1 differs only in how the object type was classified at [esi+0x8C]/[esi+0x88], not in the frame formula.
type_paths.type3_monster: 0x405A0F: action id bx = [esi+0x8B]<<8 | [esi+0x8A] (bl=[0x8B], bh=[0x8A] bounds checks; sub-dispatch via byte table 0x405DAC + jump table 0x405D98, cases @0x405A56/0x405A5D/0x405A64 set [esp+0x18]; @0x405A6D step-fx attach 0x40A4D0(0x5600FC, state+0x22F, dir) + [0x61BBC]=1 @0x405A8A). Table lookup 0x44A240(0x8AA5A8, bx); frame [0xB4] = start[state] + ((bx%10)*100 + argDir)*10 (per-dir 10 frames, per-action-rem 1000); special bx==0x8D && state==4 @0x405B11 -> [0xB4] = word[0x8AA69E] + (dir*5+0xFA)*4; [0xBC] = duration. Type-3 bound cmp al,0xB; jae bail (states 0-0xA).
type_paths.type0x32_npc: 0x405BBB: cl=[esi+0x8A]; cmp cl,0x64; jae bail. bl=[esp+0x14] (state); cmp bl,3; jae bail (3 states). argDir %= 3 (idiv, rem stored [esp+0x18] @0x405BE6). state==1 && storedDir in {0x18,0x19,0x22,0x23,0x2B,0x2C,0x2D,0x2E,0x2F,0x30,0x31,0x32,0x3A} -> state=0 (0x405C32); storedDir in {0x28,0x38,0x39} -> argDir=0 (0x405C46); storedDir in {0x33..0x37,0x3B} -> state=0 AND argDir=0 (0x405C69). 0x44A090(0x8AA5A8, storedDir) action overwrite; frame [0xB4] = word[0x8AA6C8 + 6*state] + argDir*30 + storedDir*120; [0xB8] = [0xB4] + word[0x8AA6CA+6*state]; [0xBC] = word[0x8AA6CC+6*state] (0x405C73-0x405CD0).
type_paths.bail: 0x405D47: all reject paths converge; returns 0 (eax=0). Type 2 and types 4..0x31 are hard no-ops (idx4).

setaction_dispatch.common_tail: 0x405CD7 (entered with ecx = duration from all paths): [esi+0xBC]=duration; [esi+0xC0]=state (arg1); [esi+0xC1]=[esi+0xC2]=dir (arg2); [esi+0xC4]=[esi+0xB4] (anim frame = start frame); [esi+0xC8]=0; arg2==7 -> [esi+0x61C7D]=2 else 5 (0x405D11/0x405D1A; 0x61C7D is the loop-margin byte consumed by the tick driver and frame-advance); slow-mo flag test dword[esi+0x61C68] & 0x8000000 -> [0xBC] <<= 1 (double duration, 0x405D21-0x405D35); returns 1 (success).
setaction_dispatch.conclusion: SetAction is a two-argument validated state/dir setter: (state < 0x21 for the 33-row human table, < 0xB for the monster table, < 3 for the NPC table; dir < 8 always; object type <= 0x32 with a fixed 6-way classification). Success writes the frame window [0xB4],[0xB8],[0xBC], records state/dir in [0xC0]/[0xC1]/[0xC2], restarts the animation at [0xC4]=[0xB4], and returns 1; all validation failures return 0 without touching the state fields.

player_table.fill_chain: Constructor 0x449C80 (this=0x8AA5A8; sole direct caller 0x402046 inside the global-init block 0x401FEC-0x402046 that also inits 0x8AB130/0x8AA488/0x8AB7AC/0x8AB7B0/0x45A8C0 and sets [0x8AB138]=1) first calls 0x44A8B0 with GBK string ptr 0x47C5C4 (0x449C83-0x449C88; 0x44A8B0's only direct caller) then writes 33 player rows, then 9 monster rows, then 3 NPC rows, via row writer 0x449C50(rowptr, start, frames, duration) with lea [esi+off] row pointers (esi=0x8AA5A8). Row n lives at 0x8AA5C0 + 6n.

hit [INFERENCE: 3-frame 200ms classic hit pose]; riding machine re-applies on new-dir input + msg 0xBC7; tick 0x17->7 completion
hurt [INFERENCE: the slow 2-frame 400ms Mir hurt pose]

mounted gait B [INFERENCE: 10-frame 90ms loop, slower]; riding machine: steps>0xF, fx 0x22, msg 0xBD7, guard [0x629D1]; horse msg 0x51A
mining/fishing pair B member [INFERENCE]; tick-driver special
mining/fishing pair B member [INFERENCE]; tick-driver special

player_table.layout: Human sprite = [dir-block][state-row] with dir stride 3000 frames and 10 frames per sub-dir within a row (type 0/1): total stride 33 states x 6 bytes = 0xC6, ending exactly at 0x8AA5C0+0xC6 = 0x8AA686 (monster table start). [INFERENCE] per-row sub-block semantics (which dirs map to which 10-frame slot) are not static; formulas CONFIRMED.

monster_table.location: obj+0xDE = 0x8AA686, stride 6, seeded rows M0-M8 (states 0-8) at 0x449F72-0x44A03C; rows M9/M10 (offsets +0x114/+0x11A) are never initialized in the constructor - a deliberate gap filled at runtime by race function 0x44A240 (per EI-279). Values verified: M0 (0x000,4,0x12C)@0x449F72, M1 (0x050,6,0x82)@0x449F89, M2 (0x0A0,6,0x78)@0x449FA0, M3 (0x0F0,2,0x12C)@0x449FBA, M4 (0x140,10,0x96)@0x449FD4, M5 (0x190,6,0x96)@0x449FEE, M6 (0x1E0,10,0x96)@0x44A008, M7 (0x230,10,0x96)@0x44A022, M8 (0x280,6,0x96)@0x44A03C.
monster_table.note: These are NOT additional player states: SetAction's type-3 path bounds states to < 0xB (0x405A0F) and the table is addressed through action-id lookups (0x44A240), never through SetAction state indexes 0x21+. Frame-refresh sibling 0x4056xx (painter) reads [0x8AA686 + 6*state] with state=[esi+0xC0] for monster objects.

npc_table.location: obj+0x120 = 0x8AA6C8, 3 rows seeded at 0x44A053/0x44A06A/0x44A081 (this session's byte-exact offsets; these are the rows previously labelled M0xA-M0xC in working notes - they are NPC defaults, values (0x000,4,0x12C), (0x01E,10,0x12C), (0x03C,6,0x12C)). Overwritten per-action by 0x44A090 (action 0x1B..0x3B dispatch per EI-279). Type-0x32 path 0x405BBB reads this table: 3 states, storedDir < 0x64, argDir%3, state-1 special dir list, frame = start + argDir*30 + storedDir*120.
npc_table.readers: 0x405295 (3-dir object refresh inside 0x4051xx), 0x405825 (monster refresh in 0x4057xx), 0x405CAE (SetAction type-0x32) - all read word[0x8AA6C8+6*state]. No in-file data at 0x8AA6C8 (loader-zeroed BSS); only the constructor writes exist statically.

riding_machine.fn: 0x410B00 (movement/input handler, arg [esp+0x2C] = new-dir or -1): re-applies the current mounted state whenever the rider changes direction; call convention push dir; push state; call [eax+0x10] (=SetAction(state, dir)).
riding_machine.state7: 0x410BE6: [esi+0x89]==7 (current action) && [esp+0x2C]==-1 (no new dir) -> SetAction(7, dir) + msg 0xBC7 via 0x451450(0x8AB828, msg, x, y, dir) + clear [0x62AE8] + [0x62A4C]=0.
riding_machine.dir_walk: 0x410C52: byte[0x629D3]==0 && word[0x62A77]>7 -> SetAction(current state, dir) + fx 0x1A (0x40A4D0(0x5600FC, 0x1A, dir)) + msg 0xBD1 + [0x629D3]=2.
riding_machine.other: fx 0xC / msg 0xBCB @0x410DD3; fx 7 / msg 0xBCA @0x410E49; stand state 0 / msg 0xBD0 (guard [0x629D4], threshold >3) @0x410ECB.
riding_machine.semantics: The four one-shot guard bytes are gated on ==0 (unset) and set to 2 when the corresponding state is (re)issued - i.e. each state re-issues at most once per unset period; [0x62A77] is the step counter with thresholds 7 (dir-walk), 0xB (state 0x10), 0xF (state 0x11), 3 (stand). Earlier working notes saying the guards gate on ==1 are WRONG; the cmp operand is bl which is 0 at these sites (verified).

horse_machine.fn: 0x40E400 (session-level handler; msg dispatch on ax): msg 0x51A -> SetAction(0x11) + fx 0x22 + [0x629D1]=2; msg 0x51B (block 0x40E54D-0x40E566) -> SetAction(0x10) + fx 0x23 + [0x61BBC]=0 + [0x629D2]=2; msg 0x51C -> SetAction(0x12). Consistent with the riding machine's pairing: state 0x10 <-> guard 0x629D2 / fx 0x23 / msg 0xBD8; state 0x11 <-> guard 0x629D1 / fx 0x22 / msg 0xBD7.
horse_machine.note: 0x51A/0x51B/0x51C are session-internal command codes (client-side), distinct from the riding machine's 0xBD7/0xBD8/0xBC7/0xBD0/0xBD1 message ids that go to the server via 0x451450.

tick_driver.gate: 0x411AB0: returns 0 (0x411AD6-0x411ADE) unless [esi+0xC0] (state) in {0x15, 0x16, 0x1E, 0x1F, 0x17, 5} (0x411AB8-0x411AD4); then [0xC8]=0 (0x411AE3); timer [0x62A4C] vs 0x1F40 (0x411AE9-0x411AF4, wrap both counters); [0x61BC4] vs 0x1388 (0x411B02-0x411B14); per-actor tick divider [0x61C84] (wrap at 0x186A0, skip unless tick % divider == 0, 0x411B76-0x411BB2).
tick_driver.state5: [esi+0x61B98] += 2 per tick, clamped to [esi+0x61B99]; on reach, frame+1 and [0x61B98]=limit (0x411BC9-0x411BFA) - a byte-accumulator loop animation.
tick_driver.state_0x17: frame [0xC4] += 2 per tick, clamped to end [0xB8] (0x411C07-0x411C22); end-anim flag [0x62A3C]: if set and frame > [0xB8]-3, restore movement via 0x410720 (saves [0x62AE4]=[0xC1], [0x62A40]/[0x62A44], 0x411C3D-0x411C63) then SetAction(7, [0xC1]) via vtable+0x10 at 0x411C76 (push [esi+0xC1]; push 7; call [edx+0x10]) and returns 1 (0x411C7E-0x411C89) - the 0x17 -> 7 auto-transition.
tick_driver.normal: frame+1 and 0x40CD00 spawn-fx (0x411C8C-0x411C9B); state 5 (0x411CA0-0x411CCF) and non-5 (0x411CD1-0x411CF1) completion checks: frame >= [0xB8] - [0x61C7D] && [0x61C80]==0 -> 0x4068B0 + [0x61C80]=1 (completion callback, 0x411CF3-0x411CFA).
tick_driver.auto_transition: 0x41200C (state-completion dispatch; entered when frame >= end): state-5..0x1F byte table 0x412094 via jump table 0x412088 (27 entries; states not listed fall through 0x412065 -> return). Two families: 0x41202B (frame-diff [0xC4]-[0xB4] + [0xEC] arg -> 0x43B880) and 0x41203F ([0xEC] + [0x61B98] -> 0x43B880) - both pass dir=[0xC2] and call the per-object completion routine 0x43B880 (arg layout: 0x412051 mov ecx,[esi+0x62A58]).
tick_driver.frame_advance: per EI-279 0x40C4B0: tick accumulator [0x61C5C] += dt; when tick > [0xBC] frame++ capped at [0xB8]; loop wrap [0xC4]=[0xB4] triggers vtable+0x10(0,[0xC1]) callback (frame-loop restart), then vtable+0x18 draws.

spawn_fx.fn: 0x40CD00 (spawn-effect emitter, ecx=actor): state [ecx+0xC0] in {0x15, 0x16, 0x1E, 0x1F, 0x17, 5} gate; frame-based triggers:
spawn_fx.state_0x1E: fx 0x21 when frame == [0xB4]+1 (0x40CD52 via 0x45AFC0) and fx 0x22 when frame == [0xB4]+4 (0x40CD7C) - two effects at loop start, supporting pair A as a loop state.
spawn_fx.state_0x1F: fx 0x23 when frame == [0xB4]+3 (0x40CDB5 region) - one effect, supporting pair B as the end state.
spawn_fx.group_1: states 0x15/0x16/0x17/5 -> fx id 1 (push 1 @0x40CE03, call 0x45AFC0 @0x40CE0A) when frame == [0xB8]-5 or [0xB8]-2, or when byte matches [0x61B98]/[0x61B99]-2 (0x40CDBE-0x40CDF1).

handler_pairs.pair_a: 0x40DB40: SetAction(0x15) @0x40DB58 / SetAction(0x1E) @0x40DB68, sets [0xEC]=1 @0x40DB7C (start/loop and end of pair A).
handler_pairs.state_0x17: handlers @0x40D7A1 and @0x40D882 ([0xEC]=1), third @0x40D9FD ([0x61B98]=0, [0x61B99]=6); completion return states @0x40DE9D/0x40DEB0/0x40DEB4 -> SetAction @0x40DEB6 with states 0x13/0xF/0x20 (0x17's end transitions); stand push 0 @0x40DDAB; push 0x1D @0x40DDBB.
handler_pairs.pair_semantics: [INFERENCE] 0x15/0x1E = one channel (mining or fishing; 0x1E emits two fx), 0x16/0x1F = the other (0x1F emits one fx); which is mining vs fishing is not decodable statically (packet/string evidence would be required) - KEPT pending. State 0x14 has NO SetAction writer anywhere in .text (all push 0x14 sites are message/event ids) and no other push 0x460/0x520 stride exists - dormant/reserved row.

restore_helper.fn: 0x410720 (restore-movement helper): restores saved x/y/dir/frame from [0x62AE0]/[0x62ADC]/[0x62AE4]/[0xB4], zeroes step-fx fields; guarded by [0x61C74]==0; called from tick-driver 0x17-end (0x411C69) and the riding machine.

step_fx_catalog.selector: 0x40A4D0(actor, 0x5600FC, fxid, dir): dir lookup 0x449B90 on table object 0x8AA5A8, 5-byte rows -> [0x61BA0]/[0x61BA4]/[0x61B9C], [esi+0x8D]=[row+0xA].
step_fx_catalog.msgs: 0x451450(0x8AB828, msg, x, y, dir) sends to server; catalog: state 7 -> 0xBC7, dir-walk -> 0xBD1, 0x10 -> 0xBD8, 0x11 -> 0xBD7, fx 0xC -> 0xBCB, fx 7 -> 0xBCA, stand -> 0xBD0.

errata: Type-1 path 0x405997 uses the SAME 3000/10 frame formula as type 0 - the '750/40 stride' note from an earlier working session was a misread and is superseded (0x4059D8-0x4059E7 disassembled this session).
Riding-machine guard bytes gate on ==0 and are SET to 2 when the state is issued (bl==0 cmp verified at 0x410D2B/0x410CC5/0x410C52/0x410ECB) - the earlier 'gate on ==1' reading was wrong.
0x405F80 region is an attack-FX emitter table (fx 0x47/0x48/0x49 -> 0x45AFC0(0x8AB130,...)) - NOT a SetAction/state-7 writer; the earlier 'push 7 @0x405FCD' label was a mislabel.
Rows previously numbered '0x21+' and 'M0xA-M0xC' in working notes are respectively the monster table (0x8AA686, states 0-8 + race gap) and the NPC table (0x8AA6C8) - not extra player states.

The human row table numbering in this file (state 0 at 0x449C9C, stride 6 through state 0x20 at 0x449F5B) is the authoritative one; an earlier session's off-by-one numbering (starting rows at the 0x1E call) is superseded.
verdict: SetAction (vtable slot +0x10, 0x4058E0) is a fully-validated (state,dir) frame-setter: dir<8, object type <=0x32 with byte-table dispatch (type 0/1 -> 33-state human table 0x8AA5C0 with frame = start[state] + storedDir*3000 + argDir*10; type 3 -> monster table 0x8AA686 via action-id lookups; type 0x32 -> NPC table 0x8AA6C8 with dir%3; types 2,4..0x31 -> no-op), and a common tail that commits state/dir to [0xC0]/[0xC1]/[0xC2], restarts the animation at [0xB4], applies the dir-7 loop-margin and slow-mo duration doubling, and returns 1 (0 on validation failure). The 33 player rows (init 0x449C9C-0x449F5B) cover stand/walk/run, 1-frame attack strikes, hit/hurt, 6-frame attack chains, cast, the mounted gait pair (0x10 fast/0x11 slow, driven by riding machine 0x410B00 with fx 0x23/0x22 and msgs 0xBD8/0xBD7 and horse machine 0x40E400 msgs 0x51A/0x51B/0x51C), the special families (5/0x15/0x16/0x1E/0x1F with tick-driver byte/frame accelerators and spawn-fx 0x21/0x22/0x23/1), and 0x17 with its 0x17->7 end-of-anim auto-transition (tick 0x411C76) and completion targets 0x13/0xF/0x20 (0x40DEB6). Semantic names of the exotic states (mining vs fishing, exact mounted walk/run mapping) remain [INFERENCE] or pending where only runtime/packet evidence could decide.

conclusions.claim: SetAction = vtable slot +0x10 of the shared actor vtable family (0x476480/0x4763D0/0x476554/0x47672C), address 0x4058E0, convention (ecx=actor, arg1=state at [esp+0x14], arg2=dir at [esp+0x18], ret 8). Entry validation: dir<8, table-type byte [esi+0x8C]<0x8C, object type [esi+0x88]<=0x32; per-object lazy row base [esi+0x90]=0x5600FC+[esi+0x8C]*324 computed at 0x405900-0x40591C. Dispatch: byte table 0x405D64 (types 0,1->idx0/1, 2->idx4, 3->idx2, 4..0x31->idx4, 0x32->idx3) into jump table 0x405D50 {0x405942,0x405997,0x405A0F,0x405BBB,0x405D47}; type 2 and 4..0x31 are verified no-ops returning 0.

Type-0 (0x405942) and type-1 (0x405997) human paths share identical bounds (stored dir [esi+0x8A]<9, state<0x21) and the identical frame formula [0xB4] = word[0x8AA5C0+6*state] + storedDir*3000 + argDir*10, [0xB8]=[0xB4]+frames, [0xBC]=duration (rows from the same 33-row table). The '750/40 stride' distinction in earlier notes is a misread and superseded.

The player frame table is 33 rows at 0x8AA5C0 (= table object 0x8AA5A8 + 0x18), stride 6 (start u16, frames u16, duration-ms u16), written by constructor 0x449C80 (sole caller 0x402046; also calls 0x44A8B0 with string 0x47C5C4) via row writer 0x449C50 at init calls 0x449C9C-0x449F5B. Rows: 0=(0,4,200) stand, 1=(0x50,6,100) walk, 2=(0xA0,5,75) run, 3=(0xF0,5,75), 4=(0x140,1,100), 5=(0x190,1,100) special, 6=(0x1E0,1,100), 7=(0x230,3,200) hit, 8=(0x280,2,400) hurt, 9-0xE six 6-frame 85ms attack chain rows, 0xF=(0x4B0,3,100) cast, 0x10=(0x500,10,70) mounted gait A, 0x11=(0x550,10,90) mounted gait B, 0x12=(0x5A0,10,70) mounted stand, 0x13=(0x5F0,10,120), 0x14=(0x640,10,100) dormant, 0x15-0x18 (0x690..0x780) gaits, 0x19-0x1C sit/dance family, 0x1D=(0x910,4,200), 0x1E/0x1F=(0x960/0x9B0,6,100) special pair B, 0x20=(0xA00,3,100). Semantic names are [INFERENCE] except where machine wiring confirms them (hit=7, mounted=0x10/0x11/0x12).

The rows after the human table are the monster table at 0x8AA686 (obj+0xDE, states 0-8 seeded at 0x449F72-0x44A03C, gap rows at +0x114/+0x11A filled by race fn 0x44A240) and the NPC table at 0x8AA6C8 (obj+0x120, 3 rows at 0x44A053/0x44A06A/0x44A081, overwritten per-action by 0x44A090). They are NOT extra player states: SetAction's type-3 path bounds states <0xB and type-0x32 path <3.

Common tail 0x405CD7 commits the new action: [0xBC]=duration, [0xC0]=state, [0xC1]=[0xC2]=dir, [0xC4]=[0xB4] (animation restart), [0xC8]=0, dir==7 -> [0x61C7D]=2 else 5 (loop margin consumed by tick/advance completion checks), slow-mo flag dword[0x61C68]&0x8000000 doubles [0xBC]; returns 1. All validation failures return 0 at 0x405D47 without mutating state.

Riding machine 0x410B00: state 7 re-apply on new-dir=-1 (@0x410BE6, msg 0xBC7); dir-walk when [0x629D3]==0 and steps [0x62A77]>7 (fx 0x1A, msg 0xBD1, flag=2); state 0x10 when [0x629D2]==0 and steps>0xB (SetAction(0x10,dir), fx 0x23, msg 0xBD8, [0x629D2]=2, [0x62A4C]=0); state 0x11 when [0x629D1]==0 and steps>0xF (fx 0x22, msg 0xBD7, [0x629D1]=2); fx 0xC/msg 0xBCB @0x410DD3, fx 7/msg 0xBCA @0x410E49, stand state 0/msg 0xBD0 @0x410ECB. Guards gate on flag==0 (then set to 2), NOT ==1.

Horse machine 0x40E400: msg 0x51A -> SetAction(0x11)+fx 0x22+[0x629D1]=2; msg 0x51B (0x40E54D-0x40E566) -> SetAction(0x10)+fx 0x23+[0x61BBC]=0+[0x629D2]=2; msg 0x51C -> SetAction(0x12). Matches the riding machine pairing 0x10<->0x629D2/fx0x23/msg0xBD8 and 0x11<->0x629D1/fx0x22/msg0xBD7.

Tick driver 0x411AB0 gates on state in {0x15,0x16,0x1E,0x1F,0x17,5}, clears [0xC8], maintains per-actor counters [0x62A4C]/[0x61BC4]/[0x61C84] (0x411AE9-0x411BB2), and special-cases: state 5 advances byte accumulator [0x61B98]+=2 clamped to [0x61B99] with frame+1 on reach (0x411BC9-0x411BFA); state 0x17 advances frame +=2 clamped to [0xB8] (0x411C07-0x411C22) and, when end-anim flag [0x62A3C] is set and frame > [0xB8]-3, restores movement via 0x410720 and auto-transitions 0x17->7 via SetAction(7,[0xC1]) through vtable+0x10 (0x411C3D-0x411C89); normal states frame+1 + spawn-fx 0x40CD00 (0x411C8C-0x411C9B) with completion callback 0x4068B0 + [0x61C80]=1 when frame >= [0xB8]-[0x61C7D] (0x411CA0-0x411CFA); state-completion dispatch 0x41200C routes states 5-0x1F through byte table 0x412094 / jump table 0x412088 to 0x43B880 with [0xEC]/[0x61B98]/frame-diff args.

Spawn-fx 0x40CD00 emits per-frame effects for the special states: 0x1E -> fx 0x21 @ frame==[0xB4]+1 (0x40CD52) and fx 0x22 @ frame==[0xB4]+4 (0x40CD7C); 0x1F -> fx 0x23 @ frame==[0xB4]+3; 0x15/0x16/0x17/5 -> fx id 1 (push 1 @0x40CE03) when frame == [0xB8]-5 or [0xB8]-2 or matching [0x61B98]/[0x61B99]-2 (0x40CDBE-0x40CDF1). Emitter 0x45AFC0(0x8AB130,...).

Handler pairs: 0x40DB40 SetAction(0x15)/SetAction(0x1E) with [0xEC]=1; 0x40DC20 SetAction(0x16) [0xEC]=2 / SetAction(0x1F) [0xEC]=3; 0x17 handlers at 0x40D7A1/0x40D882 ([0xEC]=1) and 0x40D9FD ([0x61B98]=0,[0x61B99]=6); 0x17 completion returns to states 0x13/0xF/0x20 at 0x40DEB6. [INFERENCE] 0x15/0x1E and 0x16/0x1F are the two mining/fishing channels (which is which needs packet/string evidence - pending). State 0x14 has no SetAction writer anywhere in .text (dormant/reserved).

Restore helper 0x410720 restores saved x/y/dir/frame from [0x62AE0]/[0x62ADC]/[0x62AE4]/[0xB4] and zeroes step-fx fields, guarded by [0x61C74]==0; used by the tick 0x17-end path (0x411C69) and riding machine. Step-fx selector 0x40A4D0(actor, 0x5600FC, fxid, dir) uses dir lookup 0x449B90 on 0x8AA5A8 (5-byte rows -> [0x61BA0]/[0x61BA4]/[0x61B9C], [esi+0x8D]=[row+0xA]).

Type-3 monster path 0x405A0F uses action id bx = [esi+0x8B]<<8|[esi+0x8A], table lookup 0x44A240, frame = start[state] + ((bx%10)*100 + argDir)*10, special bx==0x8D&&state==4 -> word[0x8AA69E] + (dir*5+0xFA)*4; bounds states <0xB. Type-0x32 NPC path 0x405BBB: 3 states, storedDir<0x64, argDir%3, per-dir 30-frame / per-storedDir 120-frame stride, 0x44A090 action overwrite.
